detail.captainAbility: Reduces STR and DEX characters' Special charge time by 2 turns at start of quest, reduces Free Spirit characters' Special charge time a further 1 turn, boosts STR, DEX, and Free Spirit characters' ATK by 5x and HP by 1.3x, boosts their ATK by 5.5x in turns where "Coordinated Giant Arm and Sniping" is used, and makes crew's [DEX][RCV] slots have matching slot effects. If a [Straw Hat Pirates], [Giant], or [Four Emperors] crewmate uses a Special, reduces this character's Special charge time by 5 turns (up to 3 times per quest). If 3 or more [Straw Hat Pirates], [Giant], or [Four Emperors] characters are on the crew, boosts Free Spirit characters' ATK by a further 1.1x, and for any character on the crew with Barrier Pierce as a Potential Ability and that meets the requirements for it to activate, reduces all enemies' damage reduction duration by 3 turns when landing a successful PERFECT strike with that character.
detail.specialText: Delays all enemies for 1 turn, ignoring immunity to Delay, immunity to all status effects, or immunity excluding certain status effects, changes crew's slots including [BLOCK] and [STR] slots to [DEX], reduces DEX and STR characters' Special charge time by 2 turns, reduces crew's Special Bind duration by 7 turns, and boosts damage dealt to delayed enemies by 3.25x for 1 turn. If this character has used "Coordinated Giant Arm and Sniping" 1 or more times and 4 or more [Straw Hat Pirates], [Giant], or [Four Emperors] characters are on the crew, boosts damage dealt to enemies with increased damage taken status by 2.75x for 1 turn, and further increases crew's slot effect boost by 1.2x up to a maximum of 15x.
sailorAbilities: Character cannot be blown away by attack, and makes STR and DEX characters' [QCK][BOMB] slots have matching slot effects.
Reduces character's Special charge time by 3 turns every time another [Straw Hat Pirates] [Giant] [Four Emperors] character uses a Special (4 times per quest).
